question.english: You mentioned in the survey that weather can be quite variable. Tell me about a time when you were completely surprised by unexpected weather. What happened, and how did you handle the situation?
question.korean: 설문조사에서 날씨가 꽤 변덕스러울 수 있다고 언급하셨습니다. 예상치 못한 날씨 때문에 크게 당황했던 경험에 대해 이야기해 주세요. 무슨 일이 있었고 그 상황을 어떻게 대처했나요?
question.combo_context: 돌발 주제 '날씨와 계절' 3연속 콤보 중 3번 문항입니다. 1번(선호하는 계절 특징)과 2번(과거 대비 계절 변화)에 이어, 3번에서는 예측 불가능했던 특정 날씨 사건과 대처 경험을 묻는 구체적 과거 서사 요구 문항입니다.

model_answer.script:
Well, speaking of weather, I actually had a super memorable experience last summer when I was completely caught off guard by a sudden storm.

You know, summers here usually bring an intense heatwave with oppressive heat, so I fully expected a bright, sunny day. However, the weather had other plans that afternoon.

I remember I was taking a leisurely walk in a park nearby. Out of nowhere, the sky turned pitch black and torrential rain started pouring down. My clothes were totally soaked through in just a few seconds, so I had to scramble to seek shelter under a small cafe canopy. Looking back, I really should have dressed in layers or checked the radar before stepping outside.

The funny thing is, after about twenty minutes, the sky began to brighten up, leaving behind this incredibly crisp air. The sudden shower actually washed away the heavy humidity and cooled down the whole city.

Looking back, even though I got totally drenched at the time, it turned out to be a refreshing shift in the weather. Nowadays, I never step outside without checking the live forecast first!
model_answer.structure_note:
서론: 갑작스러운 폭우로 방심했던 경험 소개
MP: 평소 여름의 찌는 듯한 폭염을 예상했으나 날씨 반전이 일어남
디테일: 공원 산책 중 갑자기 내린 폭우, 푹 젖은 옷, 카페 천막 아래 피신 상황
감정/생각: 당황스러웠지만 비가 갠 후 선선해진 공기와 쾌적함에 대한 소회
마무리: 교훈을 얻고 사전 예보 확인을 생활화하게 된 현재 모습
al_points: 과거 진행형(was taking)과 갑작스러운 사건(started pouring down)을 구어체 필러(you know, out of nowhere)와 결합하여 자연스러운 과거 서사를 구현했습니다.
과거의 예기치 못한 당황스러운 대처 경험과 현재의 대비 습관을 극적으로 비교하여 시간 표현의 입체성을 보여주었습니다.
oppressive heat, soaked through, crisp air 등 구체적인 감각 및 풍경 묘사 어휘를 사용해 상황을 생생하게 전달했습니다.

patterns.pattern: I fully expected [noun/gerund], but [subject] had other plans.
patterns.usage_today: I fully expected a bright, sunny day, but the weather had other plans that afternoon.
patterns.extra_example: I fully expected a smooth presentation, but the technical equipment had other plans.

patterns.pattern: Looking back, even though [clause], it turned out to be [noun/adjective].
patterns.usage_today: Looking back, even though I got totally drenched at the time, it turned out to be a refreshing shift in the weather.
patterns.extra_example: Looking back, even though we got lost in the woods, it turned out to be a great adventure.

review_words.new_example: Traveling to cold regions during winter really broadened my horizons regarding extreme weather conditions.
I was suffering from jet lag, and the sudden heatwave made me feel even more exhausted.
Despite the language barrier, local residents helped me seek shelter when the heavy storm hit.
While waiting for the storm to pass, I decided to sample local food at a cozy nearby diner.
I had to book a stay near the station because the severe weather canceled all train services.
I always double-check the itinerary whenever extreme rain warnings are issued.
Even when I pack light for summer trips, carrying a compact foldable umbrella is an absolute must.
We decided to hit the road early in the morning before the oppressive heat became unbearable.

review_patterns.pattern: On top of that, I faced [noun] because [clause].
review_patterns.new_example: On top of that, I faced severe flight delays because the typhoon swept through the coastal area.
review_patterns.mini_mission: 이 패턴과 오늘 배운 단어 'oppressive heat'를 함께 써서 한 문장 말해보기: "On top of that, I faced severe dehydration because I had to walk in the oppressive heat for hours."
